name: Trà sen
note: Green tea laid in lotus flowers from the lake for seven nights, one flower at a time, until the leaf carries the scent on its own.
leaf: Green leaf, loose, scented with lotus
brewing: 5g, water off the boil, four pours

name: Trà nhài
note: Scented fresh each summer while the jasmine is open. The everyday pot in this shop, and the tin most people leave with.
leaf: Green leaf, loose, scented with jasmine
brewing: 5g, water off the boil, three pours

name: Oolong
note: Half-oxidised leaf, rolled tight. It stands up to five or six pours and keeps a month after the tin is opened.
